title: Fix AdminController duplicate POST routes and add rate limiting
description:
P1 findings from 10-agent swarm codebase audit (P1-008, P1-010). AdminController has two [HttpPost("setup")] actions disambiguated by [Consumes] only — POST without Content-Type header triggers 500. Also setup endpoint lacks [EnableRateLimiting] while login has it.

File: MemorySmith.App/Controllers/AdminController.cs (lines 38-45, 51, 60)
Confidence: 90%
Source: codebase-audit-20260710-agent10-swarm-v2.md

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Fixed duplicate [HttpPost('setup')] routes by adding catch-all for missing Content-Type. Added [EnableRateLimiting('login')] to all setup endpoints. Verified: 3 admin contract tests pass. Commit 6281037.
